preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 500, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and the minimum of n(n - 1) or 100000, inclusive.
Each vertex in the graph is between 1 and n, inclusive, and u is not equal to v.

preconditions.expression: Each ordered pair (u, v) is listed at most once
preconditions.description: Each directed edge from u to v appears at most once in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if it is possible to make the graph acyclic by removing at most one edge, or 'NO' otherwise.
